name: paper_id
description: Stable benchmark row identifier for the active spatial-transcriptomics paper.
evidence_expectation: No supporting evidence required; this is a curator-assigned identifier.

name: pdf_filename
description: Renamed active PDF filename stored in the dataset pdfs directory.
evidence_expectation: No evidence required beyond matching the curated active file.

name: paper_title
description: Paper title exactly as shown in the PDF title page or metadata, normalized only for spacing.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title page or PDF metadata.

name: doi
description: Canonical DOI for the paper when confidently visible in the PDF; otherwise leave blank.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title page, footer, or preprint DOI line.
scoring_notes: Exact DOI string when present; blank is correct if the PDF does not expose a confident DOI.

name: year
description: Publication or posted year visible in the PDF front matter.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the journal header, footer, or preprint posted-date line.

name: journal
description: Journal or preprint venue name shown by the PDF.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from journal masthead, footer, or venue line.

name: publisher_family
description: High-level publisher family when clear from the venue; otherwise leave blank.
evidence_expectation: Derived from the visible venue identity and standard publisher ownership.
scoring_notes: Use the curated family names exactly when the mapping is clear.

name: spatial_platform_or_method
description: Primary spatial platform, protocol, or named method developed or used centrally in the paper.
evidence_expectation: Usually text evidence from the title, abstract, and first results section.
scoring_notes: Prefer the method name the paper foregrounds, not a generic umbrella field.

name: tissue_or_disease_context
description: Biological tissue, organ, developmental context, or disease setting that anchors the main spatial analysis.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the abstract, sample description, and early result figures.
scoring_notes: Use the central tissue context, not every validation tissue mentioned.

name: sample_or_section_type
description: Sample unit or preparation type used for the main spatial assay, such as fresh frozen tissue section, FFPE section, organoid, or intact tissue block.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from methods summaries or sample descriptions; figure labels may help.
scoring_notes: Capture the main assayed specimen format, not every sample type in the paper.

name: spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit
description: Resolution or capture-unit description used for the central assay. This can be a spot size, bead size, pixel size, single-cell or single-nucleus resolution claim, or another concise capture-unit description. If the paper reports heterogeneous resolutions, record the main headline resolution used in the principal result figure.
expected_format: Number plus unit or concise capture-unit description
evidence_expectation: Usually text evidence from the abstract or methods, sometimes checked against figure captions.
scoring_notes: Use the principal headline resolution, not every alternative resolution or computational bin size.

name: main_analysis_output
description: Central downstream analysis output emphasized in the paper, such as spatial domains, cell-type maps, clone maps, ligand-receptor interactions, spatial factors, or tissue architecture.
evidence_expectation: Synthesize text from results headings and the dominant mapped output shown in figures.
scoring_notes: Choose the main output class that best represents the core result figures.

name: key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding
description: Concise biological or spatial finding derived from the core results and representative maps.
evidence_expectation: Requires synthesis across mapped figures and the corresponding result text.
example_answer: Spatial domains separated tumor-edge and immune-enriched regions with distinct transcriptional programs.
scoring_notes: Reward concise, faithful biological interpretation tied to the main map, not an overly broad summary of the whole paper.

name: representative_spatial_figure_panel
description: Figure or panel that best represents the main spatial map, tissue image, or domain visualization supporting the key finding.
evidence_expectation: Figure evidence from the panel that most clearly displays the main spatial result.
scoring_notes: Equivalent figure-panel references are acceptable when the same spatial map is clearly intended.

name: validation_or_followup_method
description: Main validation or orthogonal follow-up method used to support the spatial findings, if present.
expected_format: Semicolon-separated short method labels or blank
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from results or methods, occasionally clarified by figure captions.
scoring_notes: Capture the main orthogonal validation method(s), not every sequencing step in the pipeline.
